next_step: Proof-of-concept: 3-week indexed reranking POC; schedule infra scoping call
indexing_scale_requirements: Target corpus: 120M documents (~100M vectors after chunking). Ingest cadence: 8-12M docs/month during peak. Retention window: 3 years for audit logs.
latency_targets: E2E 95th < 120ms for single-vector search; reranking end-to-end (embed+lookup+rerank) p95 < 250ms for 90% of traffic, acceptable burst up to 500ms.
cost_targets: $0.002 - $0.01 per query (including embedding + vector DB lookup + reranking model infer), goal <$0.005 for 80% queries.
connector_requirements: Key asks: incremental/upsert streaming, batched bulk ingestion with backpressure, metadata filters (multi-field), hybrid ANN + BM25 support, deterministic idempotent upserts, ability to push/evict KV cache hints, metrics/ingest backpressure signals, TLS + VPC peering, role-based service accounts and audit trails.
notes:
Sales notes and call snippets:
- 11/05 discovery call with CTO (J. Rivera), heavy focus on reranking and cost per query.
- Wants to avoid S3-only pipeline; prefers live connector into pgvector for transactional sync.
- Quote from CTO: "We need predictable per-query economics — can't have spikes that break cost targets."
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations: batching thresholds, quantization profiles, model variants for rerank vs embed.
- Engineering prefers PGVector for developer velocity but product team likes Pinecone/Weaviate features (replicas, TTL, namespaces).
- Security: must support SSO SAML + audit log forwarding to Splunk; KMS integration is required.
- Legal: data residency for EU customers; will require Private deployment or dedicated region.
- Risk: current benchmark with competitor shows p95 vector lookup ~220ms; CTO expects <120ms with caching.
- Quote from SE: "If we can demonstrate 2x cost/latency improvement on the POC, procurement moves fast."
